sentences.en: Don't defy their orders, just limit yourself to obeying them.
sentences.zh: 不要违抗他们的命令，只需遵守命令即可。

sentences.en: We defy our foes, for our passion makes us strong!
sentences.zh: 我们向敌人挑战吧！因为激情使我们变得强大！

sentences.en: Sentences that are not translated defy the purpose of Tatoeba.
sentences.zh: 未翻译的句子违背了塔托埃巴的目的。

senses.zh: 藐视；公然反抗；挑衅；使落空；经受住；顶住；抗住
